notes: τοῦ + ἐλθόντας συλλαβέσθαι: article unrepresented under rule 61, with that they should on the first verb of the English clause; giving that to συλλαβέσθαι remains defensible.
The and before help is licensed by the participle standing in the same clause under rules 86 and 88, so it is a helper on the verb it introduces and not added.
